regular.$description: Default body/UI weight. React Native PostScript name — loaded via expo-font as SourceSans3_400Regular in vvp_app's root layout.

italic.$description: Italic body/UI weight. React Native PostScript name — loaded via expo-font as SourceSans3_400Regular_Italic.

bold.$description: Bold weight for emphasis, labels and headings. React Native PostScript name — loaded via expo-font as SourceSans3_700Bold.

boldItalic.$description: Bold italic weight. React Native PostScript name — loaded via expo-font as SourceSans3_700Bold_Italic.

webFontFamily.$description: CSS font-family stack for web consumers. The @font-face rules themselves are registered in vvp_wp_theme/volksverpetzer/style.css — this token is just the stack value, for wherever that stylesheet's family name needs to be referenced (e.g. ui-web used standalone, outside the Divi theme).
